当您的应用需要访问、管理或展示用户设备上的图片、视频、动态照片等媒体资源时，应使用Media Library Kit
典型场景包括：通过系统图库Picker让用户选择图片或视频、在应用中嵌入相册浏览组件、将图片或视频保存到系统图库、播放动态照片、管理用户相册等
当您需要开发相册应用、图片编辑器、短视频应用、文件管理器等需要操作媒体文件的场景，或者需要使用MovingPhotoView组件播放动态照片、使用RecentPhoto组件获取最近一张图片时，也应使用Media Library Kit
接入系统照片选择器让用户从图库选择图片或视频 / Integrate the system photo picker so users can choose images or videos from the gallery
在页面中显示相册列表并按相册选择媒体资源 / Show album lists in a page and let users pick media by album
获取最近拍摄的一张照片用于头像或封面默认图 / Get the most recent photo for a default avatar or cover image
把应用生成的图片或视频保存到系统相册 / Save app-generated images or videos to the system gallery
编辑图片后覆盖原文件并回写到媒体库 / Replace the original image after editing and write it back to the media library
读取图库中的照片视频并生成缩略图列表 / Load photos and videos from the gallery and build a thumbnail list
按条件查询指定媒体文件并获取其详情信息 / Query specific media assets by conditions and fetch their details
重命名图库中的图片或视频文件 / Rename image or video files in the media library
管理动态照片资源并读取静态图和视频内容 / Manage moving photo assets and read both still image and video content
在应用内预览并播放从媒体库选中的视频 / Preview and play videos selected from the media library in the app
通过 PhotoPicker 组件实现图片视频浏览与多选 / Implement image and video browsing with multi-select using PhotoPicker
使用 AlbumPicker 和 PickerController 串联相册选择与保存流程 / Combine AlbumPicker and PickerController for album selection and save flow
preconditions: 工程已引入可用的 Media Library Kit 能力，并使用匹配的 HarmonyOS SDK API 版本 / The project includes the Media Library Kit capability and uses a compatible HarmonyOS SDK API version

若涉及读取、查询、修改或保存媒体资源，module.json5 中已声明所需权限或已采用系统 Picker/安全控件流程 / If reading, querying, modifying, or saving media assets, the required permissions are declared in module.json5 or the system picker/save-button flow is used
对受用户授权控制的媒体访问场景，用户已完成授权或将通过系统界面完成选择/授予 / For user-consent-controlled media access, the user has granted permission or will grant/select through the system UI

若使用嵌入式 Picker/RecentPhoto/MovingPhotoView 等组件，页面 UI 上下文与组件依赖已正确配置 / If using embedded components such as PhotoPicker, RecentPhoto, or MovingPhotoView, the page UI context and component dependencies are properly configured
inputs: 媒体资源URI、资产ID或文件标识 / media asset URI, asset ID, or file identifier
选择器或组件配置参数 / picker or component configuration options
待保存或替换的图片、视频或动态照片数据 / image, video, or moving photo data to save or replace
目标相册信息或媒体筛选条件 / target album information or media filtering criteria
outputs: 相册管理模块实例 PhotoAccessHelper / PhotoAccessHelper instance for accessing and managing media library resources
系统图库 Picker 选择结果 PhotoSelectResult（包含所选图片/视频的 photoUris 等） / PhotoSelectResult from the system gallery Picker, including selected image/video photoUris
媒体资源对象 PhotoAsset（图片、视频等资源的元数据与操作入口） / PhotoAsset object representing a photo or video asset with metadata and operations
媒体资源查询结果集 FetchResult<PhotoAsset> / FetchResult<PhotoAsset> returned from media asset queries
相册对象 Album（用户相册或系统相册） / Album object representing a user or system album
相册查询结果集 FetchResult<Album> / FetchResult<Album> returned from album queries
媒体资源 URI（图片、视频、动态照片等在媒体库中的访问标识） / Media asset URI identifying photos, videos, moving photos, and other library assets
缩略图 PixelMap（通过媒体资源生成的缩略图） / PixelMap thumbnail generated from a media asset
嵌入式 PhotoPicker 组件的已选图片/视频资源结果 / Selected photo or video results emitted by the embedded PhotoPicker component
AlbumPicker 组件选中的相册对象或相册标识 / Selected Album object or album identifier emitted by AlbumPicker
RecentPhoto 组件返回的最近一张图片或视频资源信息 / Recent photo or video resource information returned by RecentPhoto
保存到系统图库后的图片/视频媒体资源或 URI / Saved image or video media asset or URI in the system gallery
PickerController 编辑替换后更新的原图媒体资源 / Original media asset updated after replacement through PickerController
动态照片对象 MovingPhoto 及其图片/视频内容资源 / MovingPhoto object and its associated image and video content resources
MovingPhotoView 可播放的动态照片显示内容 / Playable moving photo content rendered by MovingPhotoView
媒体资源变更通知数据 ChangeData / ChangeData delivered by media asset change notifications
C/C++ MediaAssetManager 请求后写入应用沙箱目标路径的媒体文件 / Media file copied to the target app sandbox path by C/C++ MediaAssetManager
媒体资源重命名或相册重命名后的更新对象 / Updated media asset or album object after rename operations

postconditions.statement: 代码已接入至少一种媒体库能力：系统Picker、嵌入式Picker组件、保存到图库、媒体资源查询/相册管理或动态照片处理 / The code integrates at least one media-library capability: system picker, embedded picker component, save-to-gallery, media query/album management, or moving photo handling
postconditions.judge_prompt: Does the edit set clearly add or modify HarmonyOS code/config to use Media Library Kit APIs or components for picking, saving, querying, album management, or moving photo handling?

postconditions.statement: 媒体访问路径采用系统授权、安全控件或已声明权限的合规方式，而非绕过授权直接操作用户媒体 / Media access follows a compliant path using system authorization, secure controls, or declared permissions rather than bypassing consent to manipulate user media directly
postconditions.judge_prompt: From the edits, is media access implemented through declared permissions, a system picker, a save button, or another authorized Media Library flow instead of an obvious unauthorized direct access pattern?

postconditions.statement: 实现结果与用户目标的媒体对象类型一致，如图片、视频、相册或动态照片 / The implementation targets the media object type the user asked for, such as image, video, album, or moving photo
postconditions.judge_prompt: Do the edits operate on the requested media type and scenario (for example image/video picking, album operations, saving to gallery, or moving photo access) rather than an unrelated media domain?
